limits: At the trial's 5-second cadence the planning figure for store growth is about 27 MB per hour (about 37 KB per collection measured at component level, times 720 collections per hour); by arithmetic from that figure the store reaches the packaged 1 GiB per-file limit after roughly 40 hours, before anything is seven days old; on this trial nothing expires and the seven-day retention target is never reached.
No same-VM recovery from a capacity refusal is supplied. Restart or reboot at the ceiling was not tested.
The remediation consumer is installed disabled; no automatic remediation has been run on these packages. Every Start is requested step by step by an operator.
AG state completed does not by itself mean the governed Start succeeded; see KNOWN-ISSUES.md.
